Pool is OPEN! Modern 1BR condo at Illume with stunning skyline views, secure garage parking, pool, gym, and private balcony. Walk to the Gulch, Edgehill, and WeHo. Perfect for couples or business travelers, with fast WiFi, full kitchen, in‑unit laundry, and an air mattress for extra guests. Bright, stylish, and close to everything Nashville offers. Enjoy resort‑style amenities in a quiet, upscale building minutes from downtown.

The space
You’ll Love:
•	Access to a heated outdoor pool, modern gym, and gas grill area — unwind or stay active with ease
•	Secure indoor garage parking — included for peace of mind in a prime location
•	Comfortably sleeps up to 4 guests with a queen pull-out sofa in the living room
•	Full kitchen stocked with essentials, in-unit washer/dryer, Smart TV, and high-speed Wi-Fi
•	Minutes from the Gulch, Edgehill, Weho, Broadway, The Ryman, Bridgestone Arena, and Nashville’s top dining spots

Guest access
Building Amenities: You’re welcome to enjoy the building's heated pool, fitness center, and free parking garage during your stay. Please note that the pool is available seasonally, pool and gym hours may vary.

Note: The condo is entirely yours, but common areas of the building, such as the lobby and hallways, are shared with other residents.
